title: Photo Duo 113 · 아워글래스 SSBBW × 텐트폴 USSBBW · 나란히 기대기
prompt:
Image format: a horizontal landscape-orientation photograph, 3:2 aspect ratio, wider than it is tall.

A photograph of TWO women reclining side by side against the same padded backrest on a low platform, a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, the camera set close at platform level so the two of them fill the frame edge to edge, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subjects: TWO real adult women, both far beyond any real person in size, propped at about 45 degrees with their legs stretched out in front of them, their two bodies together filling the frame from edge to edge and top to bottom with almost no empty backdrop left, their hips and sides pressed against each other and the flesh bulging out where they touch.

Left woman: an East African woman in her late 30s, deep umber skin with a warm sheen, her face exactly the same tone as her body, thick twin braids over her shoulders. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — the one place on her body where the outline pulls inward. Below it a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and spills forward down the slope of her raised torso under its own weight, piling over her thighs and reaching toward her knees in two or three heavy rounded folds with deep creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, merging seamlessly into her sides, hips and thighs with no boundary anywhere, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, a gigantic rear, gigantic soft thighs, very thick soft arms. Painted in Chinese Cizhou sgraffito — a glossy jet-black glaze carved away to bold cream-white peony scrolls and leafy vines, carved cream bands following every deep crease and curve.

Right woman: a Latina woman in her late 50s, warm golden-tan skin with olive undertones, her face exactly the same tone as her body, long box braids gathered high. A giant hourglass frame flaring out at both ends: enormous flaring lats spreading to shoulders twice the width of a normal woman's, huge thick arms pushed far out by the width of her back, a colossal bust projecting past the line of her shoulders, no waist at all. A great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and spills forward down the slope of her raised torso under its own weight, piling over her thighs and reaching toward her knees in two or three heavy rounded folds with deep creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, merging seamlessly into her sides, hips and thighs with no boundary anywhere, not pregnant. Below it colossal wide hips just as broad as her shoulders and a huge rounded rear; the muscle is rounded and soft-edged under a thick layer of fat. Painted in Russian Palekh miniature — a deep black ground with fine gold linework and jewel-toned firebirds, horses and winter forests in crimson, emerald and ultramarine, a gold border band following every curve.

Their outer arms rest back on the platform with the elbows out, their inner hands on their own thighs. On both: real photographic skin with visible pores, creases where the flesh folds and faint stretch marks, no illustration finish, no CG sheen. The paint is pigment on living skin, distorting over every bulge and cracking where it folds, covering everything below the jaw with no bare skin left; their faces unpainted, the pattern fading out at the neck. Neither arm crosses in front of her own body or the other woman's, both faces toward the camera. Every fold keeps its own rounded outline with a deep crease between them, never one shapeless mass; arms, hands and legs in correct proportion. Both wear extreme platform stiletto heels with soles as tall as their ankle bones.

Horizontal 3:2 landscape-orientation photograph, wider than it is tall.
